options.summary: Give the crown an apical-rosette form: fronds borne only as a rosette at the apex of a thick unbranched stem, with no laterals and no twig clothing of the trunk, replacing the branching crown; and give that rosette's leaves the pinnate-frond structure of one pinnate frond with leaflets along a rachis, one placement, per the packet's apical-rosette and pinnate-frond needs.

Add two organs the packet finds no trait or element row for: retained petiole bases clothing the trunk as a 3D organ (the diamond boots of a date palm), and basal leaflets of the Phoenix frond modified as spines (acanthophyll), since no element or organ row currently distinguishes a spine from a leaflet or places a persistent leaf base on the stem.

Add the infructescence as its own organ: a hanging date cluster from the crown. fn-33 (open) specifies one reproductive organ slot for a flower, a cone or a fruit placed at stations as a second foliage list, but it is unsure whether a branched Phoenix spadix is one hanging organ element or a structure that single-element slot cannot draw.

Register the date-palm preset with the values the packet already finds reachable on existing dials: stems=1 (single trunk), lateral_orders=0 (unbranched monopodial axis, so laterals_per_station's unreachable 0 is moot), apical_dominance near 1, and length_taper=0 (near-constant trunk diameter). capabilities() already emits woody-axes for a registered preset; the gate lists it missing only because date-palm is not yet registered.
